_doc: map/include/map.h MP 값의 LIMO 재보정 제안. R1 값(../calib.json, 지금 map.h)은 그대로 두고, 이 파일은 LIMO 기록으로 맞춘 값이다. 근거·방법·n 은 README.md.
robot: limo_omx in BEHAVIOR/OmniGibson (sim). eyes camera 720x720 fx 306 at z 0.18 m, diff-drive, odometry = base_qvel integration (scenemap slam2d pushVelocity)
caveats: single run: SLAM residual target is ONE explore run (explore_20261004_094010_turning_on_radio_frontier_limo); odometry bias from ONE spin+straight recording (limo3); per-detection stats from that same short recording (80 keyframes, COCO-80 detector)

camera FK offset: all three LIMO runs were recorded before commit 391c04b (eyes moved +x 0.010 m to the lens). The 1 cm FK error is inside the SLAM residual target (rms 3.1 cm), so kf_corr/odo_* noise may be slightly too large for the fixed camera
explore run has no rec.bin: raw odometry and per-detection stats could not be taken from it; it uses the open-vocab detector (272, 20 prompts) while limo3 rec.bin uses COCO-80
map_drift trajectories are synthetic in the G1 room (kind 2 = LIMO-explore-like 13.4 m); real path cannot be replayed in the MP scene

odo_bt.source: limo3 rec.bin, sm_bench --robot limo_omx --pose odom vs G (GT)

odo_br.method: linear fit of yaw error vs GT yaw: +1.21 %/rad, residual std 3e-5 rad (pure bias, no noise)

odo_bw.method: odom yaw change -4e-5 rad vs GT -1e-5 rad (< 5e-5 rad/m)

odo_t.source: map_drift fit to explore SLAM residual
odo_t.n: grid 2400 + 360 points x 128 ep (CPU), check 1024 ep (GPU)
odo_t.method: loss = sum log^2 (rms xy, rms yaw weight 1; max xy, max yaw weight 0.5), kind 2

p_conf.source: explore confirmed objects vs GT AABB (open-vocab): mislabel 3/16 = 0.19
p_conf.method: map_drift kind 2 (512 ep) p_conf sweep 0.07-0.35 -> confirmed mislabel 0.18/0.21/0.25 at 0.07/0.08/0.09
p_conf.alt_coco: per-detection mislabel 32/132 = 0.24 (limo3, COCO-80); p_conf 0.24 gives confirmed mislabel 0.49 in map_drift, real COCO confirmed 6/14 (limo3), 11/19 (limo4)

p_ghost.source: limo3 rec.bin per-detection: 1 false (no GT AABB) / 133 dets, keyframes with >=1 false 1/80 = 0.013; explore confirmed false 0/16
p_ghost.method: map_drift sweep: p_ghost 0.03 -> keyframes with fake 0.012, confirmed false 0.04

lat_n.source: limo3 rec.bin correct detections, centroid robust sigma (1.4826 MAD) x/y around per-object median

p_miss_near.why: no visible (frame, object) pair < 1.5 m in limo3

p_miss_mid.why: LIMO 1.5-2.5 m: 20/74 = 0.27 but 18 of 20 misses are one wall-mounted TV (others 2/52 = 0.04); 5 objects, COCO only

p_miss_far.why: no visible pair 2.5-3.0 m; 3-6 m: drop_in_sink 10/10 missed (beyond Dabai 3 m, not used by MP)

dn0_dn2.why: Dabai datasheet, robot-independent; sim depth is noiseless

raw_odom_limo3.run: scratchpad limo3 rec.bin (14 s: spin 363 deg + 0.8 m straight)
raw_odom_limo3.tool: sm_bench --robot limo_omx --pose odom --no-dets (그때 scene_graph 서브모듈 LIMO 빌드)

map_drift_check_gpu_1024ep.base_map_h: working tree map.h md5 75b599971599101d4b56025a7777e2bd (HEAD fbae36a + uncommitted), patched copy in scratch build, see tools/map_drift_limo.patch
